title: Did MSFS 2024 Just Release World Update 22 Early? (US National Parks)
description:
s this an accidental leak or an intentional surprise from Asobo? When firing up Microsoft Flight Simulator 2020/2024 today, I was greeted by a sudden, unexpected popup: World Update 22 is available to download right now! Originally scheduled to launch on the 4th of July to celebrate America's 250th anniversary, this massive free update focuses entirely on the stunning landscapes of the U.S. National Parks.

In this video, we're taking a first look at what's inside the download, checking out the massive upgrades to over 30 National Parks and Monuments, and examining the technical changes under the hood. Asobo has partnered with Bing Places, Vexcel, and Gaia to deliver updated photogrammetry, thin Triangulated Irregular Network (TIN) surface texturing, and brand-new Digital Elevation Modeling (DEM) data across 31 distinct Areas of Interest (AOIs).

While the data is installing, the big question remains: Is the streamed photogrammetry content fully ready on the servers yet? We’ll be testing that over the coming days!

Chapters:
00:00 - WU 22: Now available
00:31 - What's included

⛰️ UPDATED NATIONAL PARKS & ACTIVITIES
Take to the skies in the Draco X, Diamond DA62, or a helicopter to explore iconic locations. This update contains brand-new Discovery Flights and activities across these stunning, updated regions:
• Acadia National Park
• Arches National Park
• Bryce Canyon National Park
• Crater Lake National Park
• Death Valley National Park
• Dry Tortugas National Park
• Everglades National Park
• Grand Canyon National Park
• Grand Teton National Park
• Great Smoky Mountains National Park
• Olympic National Park
• Zion National Park

✈️ NEW "GUIDED TOURS" MISSION TYPE
Debuting in this update, Guided Tours provide detailed narratives and audio commentary as you fly, giving you a deeply immersive educational experience while exploring virtual landscapes.

We also catch glimpses of the highly anticipated Goodyear Blimp/Zeppelin in the menu screens, which is slated to arrive alongside these scenery updates.

World Update 22 is completely free for all MSFS 2024 users. Fire up your simulator, check your updates, and see if you can download it early too! Keep an eye on the channel over the next few days as I take these aircraft up and thoroughly stress-test the new photogrammetry and terrain resolution.

If you enjoy deep dives into the latest flight sim updates, benchmarks, and tutorials, make sure to hit that subscribe button and turn on notifications!
